body.message:
We can proceed with the booking. Please note that we will send you the payment link for the deposit.

The rate from 18th July to 17th August will be AED 6,500, and from 17th August to 19th September (33 nights) the rate will be AED 7,500. The total rent for both periods will be AED 14,000 for 63 nights, and the security deposit is AED 2,000.

To confirm the 2-month booking, the first month’s rent and the deposit must be paid in advance.
